_about: Public-domain Albrecht Ritschl (1822-1889, Göttingen theologian) in English for the Word Hoard: the two English volumes of The Christian Doctrine of Justification and Reconciliation, the Critical History tr. John S. Black (Edinburgh, 1872) and The Positive Development of the Doctrine ed. H. R. Mackintosh and A. B. Macaulay (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1900), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
